title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
summaryZh: 把握時間將自己交託給基督，並分享神愛的真理。
lines: You can make that decision to follow Jesus Christ,
你可以做決定來跟隨耶穌基督，
just as these many hundreds are doing here in Syracuse, New York.
就像這幾百位在紐約州雪城這裡的人一樣。
The number on your screen is your number to call for spiritual help and counseling,
你螢幕上的號碼是你可以撥打尋求屬靈幫助和協談的電話，
It could be the most important call you've ever made.
這可能是你打過最重要的一通電話。
We're in the Carrier Dome, this beautiful, magnificent structure here in Syracuse, New York, in the central part of the state,
我們在凱莉圓頂體育場，這個位於紐約州中部雪城美麗宏偉的建築，
and what a wonderful part of America this really is.
這真的是美國一個很棒的地方。
And tonight, as you can see, there've been hundreds of people respond to come and make their commitment to Christ,
今晚，如你所見，已經有數百人回應呼召，前來將自己交託給基督，
or to renew their vows to Christ,
或是重新向基督立下誓言，
and you need to do the same thing that are watching.
而正在觀看的你們，也需要做同樣的事。
You may be in a hotel room, you may be in your own home, whatever.
你可能在飯店房間裡，可能在自己的家裡，無論在哪裡。
Make your commitment to Christ tonight.
今晚就將自己交託給基督吧。
And if you will, pick up the phone and call that number that you see,
如果你願意，請拿起電話撥打你看到的那個號碼，
and there's a counselor standing by to say a word to you and to help you.
會有一位協談員在線上跟你說幾句話，並幫助你。
May God help you to make that commitment tonight.
願神幫助你今晚做出委身的決定。
There's still time to make your personal decision for Jesus Christ.
現在還有時間為耶穌基督做出你個人的決定。
Special friends are waiting to talk with you and to pray with you.
有特別的朋友正等著和你交談，並與你一起禱告。
Just call the number now on your screen.
現在就撥打你螢幕上的號碼。
If the line is busy, write the number down and call again in a few moments.
如果佔線，請把號碼記下來，稍後再打。
We'll be here as long as the calls keep coming in.
只要一直有電話打來，我們就會在這裡。
If you just prayed that prayer with my father,
如果你剛才和我父親一起做了那個禱告，
or if you have any questions about a relationship with Jesus Christ,
或者你對與耶穌基督建立關係有任何問題，
why don't you just call that number on the screen.
為什麼不直接撥打螢幕上的那個號碼呢？
There'll be someone there to talk with you, pray with you and answer those questions.
那裡會有人與你交談、與你一起禱告，並回答那些問題。
If you would like to commit your life to Jesus Christ,
如果你想將生命交託給耶穌基督，
please call us right now toll free at 1-877-772-4559.
請現在就撥打我們的免付費電話 1-877-772-4559。
Or you can write to us at Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, North Carolina 28201.
或者你可以寫信給我們，地址是 Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, North Carolina 28201。
Or you can contact us on the web 24/7 at PeaceWithGod.tv.
或者你可以全天候在 PeaceWithGod.tv 網站上聯繫我們。
We'll get the same helps to you that we give to everyone who responds at the invitation.
我們會將給予每一位回應呼召之人的相同幫助提供給你。
On behalf of Franklin Graham and the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association,
我代表葛福臨和葛理翰佈道團，
thank you for watching, and thank you for your prayers.
感謝您的收看，也感謝您的代禱。
We still have a window of opportunity to reach a lost and dying world with the truth of God's love.
我們仍有一個機會之窗，可以用神愛的真理去接觸這個迷失且垂死的世界。
We've got an opportunity to tell others about Jesus Christ.
我們有一個機會去告訴別人關於耶穌基督的事。
What are you going to do with it?
你打算怎麼運用這個機會呢？
